cycles.title: Policy-0T non-affine simulation and MAJ3 lifting lower bound
cycles.result: C022 produced an internally complete structural induction translating every provenance-complete non-affine Policy-0T UNSAT trace to Resolution with explicit size and depth bounds, proved that MAJ3-lifted Tseitin blocks uniformly evade the current affine detector, verified exact encoding identity with the lifting definition, and derived a formalizing exponential work lower-bound chain for this exact solver core. No external proof review or terminal general-complexity conclusion is claimed.
cycles.claim_boundary: C022 does not prove P!=NP, lower-bound unrestricted SAT algorithms, classify formula caching, or simulate the full affine dispatcher. H135-H137 remain formalizing pending independent mathematical review.
